meta.name: what-breaks
meta.description: Assess the impact of a proposed change on dependencies and shared infrastructure. Use before touching unfamiliar or consequential systems.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在动手改动陌生系统前,先摸清哪些依赖和共享设施会受牵连
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果即将改动不熟悉或牵一发动全身的系统,想先知道爆炸半径
copy.tagline_en: Trace which dependencies and shared services a change will affect before you touch them
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're about to modify unfamiliar or high-stakes systems and need the blast radius first

howto.what: 在动不熟悉的或有重大影响的系统前，它会先读任务上下文约定和方法，评估拟议改动对依赖与共享基础设施的影响；被 @fde 调用时复用其脱敏包和范围，不重启设置。它会如实报告缺失能力或未运行的检查。
howto.when: 当你打算改动不熟悉的或影响大的系统、想先弄清会波及哪些依赖和共享基础设施时触发；若由 @fde 调用，则沿用它已有的范围。

say.text: 我准备改一个共享库的接口，先评估哪些依赖方会受影响。
say.note: 它会给出影响评估并保留未知项。

say.text: 动这个不熟的服务之前，先给我一份影响评估。
say.note: 它按你提供的允许上下文工作。

say.text: 不要重新做调查，沿用 @fde 当前的脱敏包和范围。
say.note: 它不会重启设置或重复已答问题。

howto.what_en: Before touching unfamiliar or high-impact systems, it reads the task context contract and method, then assesses how a change affects dependencies and shared infrastructure. Called by @fde, it reuses that sanitized packet and scope.
howto.when_en: Use it when you plan a change to an unfamiliar or high-impact system and want to know which dependencies and shared infrastructure it affects. If @fde calls it, it keeps that scope.

say_en.text: I'm about to change a shared library — assess which dependents break.
say_en.note: It assesses impact and keeps unknowns.

say_en.text: Before I touch this unfamiliar service, give me an impact assessment.
say_en.note: It works from the permitted context you supply.

say_en.text: Don't re-run discovery — reuse @fde's sanitized packet and scope.
say_en.note: It does not restart setup or re-ask answered questions.
